headline: North Central (Ill.) finishes with one defeat all season
dek: North Central (Ill.) won seventeen matches and drew two across all competitions before falling to Trinity (TX) in its final outing. The program scored 55 goals and conceded sixteen across the season, going unbeaten through conference play to finish atop the CCIW table.
